Case study, NDA

One medical history for the couple's whole treatment

Role: only designerDuration: about half a yearPlatform: web appStatus: in use in selected IVF clinics

Vitro-Soft is a Polish company that makes software for IVF clinics. Clinic staff kept treatment records on paper and in Excel. I was the only designer of the new web app, which is now used in selected IVF clinics.

Inside: the shared medical history, the embryology part, the printouts and the component library, with the reasons behind each decision.

  • 58desktop screens
  • 13printable documents
  • 87component variants in 35 sets

One password opens all three NDA case studies. It is on the first page of the CV I send with my applications. You only need to enter it once per visit. If you do not have the password, email me and I will send it.
